title: assign-prs reviewer configuration
description: Overlay declaring which members of the live GitHub team roster are eligible for automatic review assignment, and which areas each one owns. See README.md.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor validation.

team.description: GitHub team whose live membership is reconciled against this file.

reviewers.description: Reviewers each PR should end up with. The skill requests only the shortfall.

areaMatch.description: preference degrades to the whole eligible pool when nobody owns an area; hard leaves the PR under-covered instead.

unknownMemberPolicy.description: How to treat a live team member with no entry in this file.

areas.description: Area definitions. Every value in a reviewer's primary or secondary list must be a key of this map; that cross-reference is checked at run time, not by this schema.

label.description: Human-readable area name used in reports.

scopes.description: Conventional-commit scopes that identify this area, used only when paths are inconclusive.

paths.description: Glob patterns identifying this area. Paths are authoritative over scopes.

reviewers.description: Every member of the team, including ineligible ones, so nobody is silently absent.

login.description: GitHub login, matched against the live team roster.

eligible.description: Whether this person may receive automatic review requests.

fallbackEligible.description: Defaults to true. Set false to be selected only for declared areas, never for PRs that matched no area.

primary.description: Areas this person owns. Selection prefers a primary owner.

secondary.description: Areas this person can cover when no primary owner is available.
